_comment: Capture manifest for the user manual's figures (docs/manual/images/).
Driven by scripts/capture_manual_figures.sh, which launches the app with
SWMMVIS_CAPTURE_MANIFEST pointed here. One launch per 'model' group.
Row fields: name (must match a live \figtodo), action (ActionCatalog id),
widget (objectName), window (grab the main window), page (sidebar/tab text),
tab (sub-tab after page), size (WxH), lane (offscreen|live|human), settleMs.
lane:'live' rows need a real display — scene-graph content reads back blank
under the offscreen platform. lane:'human' rows are native menus/pickers the
engine refuses to drive; they are listed in tests/manual/manual_figures/.

models._comment: Passed to the launcher as SWMMVIS_OPEN_ON_STARTUP, not read by the engine.

figures._note: Pin the tab. Without it the page inherits whichever tab a previous capture left current, which produced a greyed Finite Volume tab under a dynamic-wave model instead of the default Routing tab.
